scale: Pearson correlation of observed alternate-allele indicators; model-implied correlation from fitted bivariate probit probabilities
interpretation: descriptive off-diagonal goodness-of-fit diagnostic, not a formal factor-rank test

quadrature.rule: standard-normal Gauss--Hermite factor integration; all pairs evaluated by matrix multiplication

heatmap_selection.selection_rule: largest partner-partner correlation-residual RMSE among public 1KGP loci with p >= 20
